deploy-bot: Canary roll started by @ashley -> convo-service v3.2.0 at 6% (eu-west-1:4%, us-east-1:2%). Change window 30m. ID: canary-1769999999
ashley: Starting watch. Pause if 5xx >0.7% or p99 +200ms sustained 3m.
matt: small bump in eu-west 5xx 0.15% -> 0.9% in the last 5m, looks correlated to partner-slice-21.
zoe: tracing shows repeated `InvalidToken` from auth-proxy on canary nodes. stack: auth.py:132 -> proxy.py:58. Not seen on stable.
eng-release-lead: Is it isolated to the canary cohort?
matt: yes, legacy traffic stable. Only the partner-slice traffic hitting canary.
ashley: Proposal: pin eu-west to v3.1.9 and keep us-east progressing. Vote here.
oncall-sre: +1 pin. Will lower page threshold but page if 5xx >1.5% for 5m.
matt: +1 pin. Also grab logs + heapdump before draining.
zoe: +1 pin. Looks like a token format change in v3.2.0. I'll add failing payloads to ticket RT-5010.
deploy-bot: Executing route-pin --region eu-west-1 --to v3.1.9 --reason "auth InvalidToken on canary"
deploy-bot: Route update successful. eu-west pinned to v3.1.9 (approx 4%). Canary continues in us-east (2%). Rollout ID: canary-1769999999
ashley: Noted in release notes: eu-west pause due to auth errors. Link: https://go/release/2025-05-20#1769999999-notes
eng-release-lead: QA/SRE follow up: add sample tokens to regression and validate fix. We'll reconvene in 20m.
